title: Cherry On Top
description: A complete remake of Minecraft's vanilla textures
body:
Freshly remade textures and 3D models acting as the perfect **cherry on top**! Keeping the core Minecraft experience untouched, while decorating this giant cake with **beautiful new visuals**.

**This resourcepack aims to completely remake:**

- All items and weapons (including custom animations :p)
- All mobs and entities
- The in-game environment and nature
- GUI and user interface

**And many other elements of the game!**

*(Currently in demo-version)*
